name: page-type
description: Assign a captured page to one of the project's page types (archetypes); confidence maps onto the fidelity tier (#126).

fields.page: { path, title, description, headings: [{tag, text}], counts: {ctas, links, images, words}, signals }
fields.types: the project's page types: an object of type → description, or an array of type names

instructions.question: Which of the listed page types does `page` belong to?
instructions.focus: Judge by the page's structure and role in the site (its path, headings and what it lists or presents), not by its topic. Two pages of the same type share a template.

appendNone.none: No listed type fits: the page has a structure none of the types describes.

locale_shell.instructions: Is `page` a duplicate-content locale or regional variant of another page — the same page in another language or market rather than a page of its own?

criteria.true: A language or region path prefix or suffix, a translated title of a page that also exists in the primary language.
criteria.false: A page that exists once, or a page whose content is specific to this locale.
